title: Endogenous depopulation and economic growth
title_primary: Endogenous depopulation and economic growth
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Fertility rates have declined dramatically across almost all high-income countries over the past decades. In some countries, population growth is already negative and many more are projected to exhibit negative population growth in the future. This raises concerns about potential economic prospects. Indeed, endogenous and semi–endogenous growth models imply that a shrinking workforce would lead to declining income growth and, perhaps, even to stagnation. We include an endogenous quantity/quality trade–off between fertility and human capital accumulation in these models to assess the extent to which a declining number of people (i.e., workers) may be compensated by increasing education. We demonstrate that economic growth does not necessarily decline with population shrinkage: in many scenarios, human capital investment can offset demographic headwinds and sustain technological progress.

title: Artificial Intelligence application and cross-boundary digital innovation in traditional enterprises: evidence from Chinese listed companies
title_zh: 人工智能应用与传统企业跨界数字创新：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 人工智能应用与传统企业跨界数字创新：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Artificial Intelligence application and cross-boundary digital innovation in traditional enterprises: evidence from Chinese listed companies
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Whether artificial intelligence (AI) application can encourage traditional enterprises to extend their innovation activities into digital technology fields remains insufficiently examined at the firm level. Using Chinese A-share listed traditional enterprises from 2010 to 2024, we examine whether AI application is associated with their entry into digital technology fields. The results show that AI application significantly promotes cross-boundary digital innovation in traditional enterprises, and this conclusion remains robust when alternative measures of the core variables are used and potential endogeneity concerns are mitigated. The mechanism analysis suggests that AI application supports cross-boundary digital innovation by improving innovative human capital, enhancing knowledge integration capability, and alleviating information asymmetry. The heterogeneity analysis shows that this effect is more pronounced in firms facing stronger market competition, weaker financing constraints, and lower managerial myopia. Further analysis indicates that cross-boundary digital innovation in traditional enterprises is positively associated with total factor productivity and market value. This study provides micro-level evidence for understanding how AI application supports traditional enterprises’ entry into digital technology fields.

title: Multivariate inference for dynamic systemic risk measures
title_zh: 动态系统性风险测度的多元推断
title_primary: 动态系统性风险测度的多元推断
title_secondary: Multivariate inference for dynamic systemic risk measures
authors: Yuan Chen, Nikolaus Hautsch, Jérémy Leymarie, Melanie Schienle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides statistical inference for marginal expected shortfall (MES) and delta conditional value-at-risk (ΔCoVaR) measures, which are semiparametrically estimated by a two-step procedure in a multivariate GARCH-type framework. We establish the asymptotic properties of corresponding estimators and illustrate how the estimation uncertainty can be decomposed into dynamic univariate marginal and time-varying dependence components. Our methodology reveals good finite sample performance for estimation and prediction of risk. Moreover, we propose tests for differences in systemic risk in order to construct confidence sets for companies’ ranks in systemic risk rankings. In an empirical application based on 50 large US financial institutions, our framework provides novel evidence on the informativeness of such rankings. Moreover, our findings highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying return dependence in systemic risk estimators.
abstract_zh: 本文针对边际预期缺口（MES）与德尔塔条件风险价值（ΔCoVaR）指标提供了统计推断方法，这些指标在多元GARCH型框架下通过两步程序进行半参数估计。我们确立了相应估计量的渐近性质，并阐述了估计不确定性如何分解为动态单变量边际成分与时变依赖结构成分。我们的方法在风险估计与预测方面展现出良好的有限样本性能。此外，我们提出了系统性风险差异的检验方法，以构建公司系统性风险排名中的置信集。在基于50家美国大型金融机构的实证应用中，我们的框架为这些排名的信息含量提供了新颖证据。同时，我们的发现强调了在系统性风险估计中考虑时变收益依赖性的重要性。

title: Waiting or Acting: The Effects of Environmental Regulatory Uncertainty on Green Innovation
title_zh: 等待还是行动：环境监管不确定性对绿色创新的影响

official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how environmental regulatory uncertainty affects green innovation in polluting firms. The findings suggest that, instead of adopting a passive “wait-and-see” strategy, polluting firms proactively engage in green innovation and R&D activities. To address endogeneity, I employ an instrumental variable approach using political polarization in roll-call votes on environmental and climate issues in the U.S. House of Representatives. I also exploit the proposal of the Affordable Clean Energy rule in 2018 as an exogenous shock in a difference-in-differences framework. The results are consistent with the growth options view of green innovation in polluting firms. Additional evidence suggests that environmental regulatory uncertainty leads to reductions in toxic emissions. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051 .
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境监管不确定性如何影响污染企业的绿色创新。研究发现，污染企业并未采取被动的“观望”策略，而是主动参与绿色创新与研发活动。为应对内生性问题，我采用工具变量方法，利用美国众议院关于环境与气候议题唱名投票中的政治极化作为工具。同时，我利用2018年《清洁能源负担规则》的提议作为外生冲击，在双重差分框架下进行分析。结果与污染企业绿色创新的增长期权观点一致。额外证据表明，环境监管不确定性导致有毒排放减少。本文由金融学编辑Camelia Kuhnen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051获取。

title: A Theory of International Official Lending
title_zh: 国际官方贷款理论
title_primary: 国际官方贷款理论
title_secondary: A Theory of International Official Lending
authors: Qing Liu, Zanhui Liu, Vivian Zhanwei Yue
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Official lending is large, senior, and countercyclical, continuing after sovereigns fall into arrears on private debt. We ask why sovereign finance exhibits this division of labor across creditors. In a production economy where a risk-averse sovereign privately allocates imported inputs, commitment is limited on both sides, and monitoring generates a noisy signal, the constrained-optimal allocation is decentralized by defaultable private debt, senior non-defaultable multilateral debt, and concessional bilateral debt whose relief is tied to the signal. Production remains distorted, but the sovereign is never excluded: official lending is monitored liquidity provision. A calibration reproduces procyclical private and countercyclical official debt.
abstract_zh: 官方贷款规模庞大、优先且逆周期，在主权国家拖欠私人债务后仍持续提供。我们探究为何主权融资在债权人之间呈现这种分工。在一个风险规避型主权国家私下分配进口投入品的生产经济中，双方承诺均受限，监督产生噪声信号，受约束的最优配置通过可违约的私人债务、优先的不可违约多边债务以及与信号挂钩的减让性双边债务实现分散化。生产仍存在扭曲，但主权国家从未被排除在外：官方贷款是受监督的流动性提供。校准结果再现了顺周期的私人债务与逆周期的官方债务。

abstract: Automation affects public budgets through wages and the tax base, and also through inflows into social insurance. We estimate the effect of industrial robot exposure on Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) applications using confidential commuting-zone data and a shift-share design that instruments U.S. exposure with earlier European robot diffusion. One additional robot per 1,000 workers lowers applications by about 8 per 100,000 working-age residents, with the largest declines among workers aged 55 to 64. Employment-to-population ratios do not fall in exposed commuting zones, which weighs against broad local displacement as the sole explanation. A year

title: Knowledge is power: A field experiment in the Chinese and US stock markets
title_zh: 知识即力量：中美股市的实地实验

authors: Sonia M.L. Wong, Xue Yuan, Bohui Zhang, Xiaofeng Zhao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the causal effect of financial knowledge on stock pricing efficiency. Leveraging a specially designed investor education website, we conduct a field experiment, sharing insights on the pricing of accounting accruals with investors across China and the US on social media. We find that the treatment stocks experience a reduction in accrual mispricing relative to the control stocks. This effect is particularly pronounced when knowledge that enhances the conceptual understanding of accruals is paired with knowledge that aids in the quantitative application of accruals. Furthermore, the treatment effect is strengthened among stocks with investors who engage more deeply with the educational content yet possess lower financial sophistication.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融知识对股票定价效率的因果效应。借助一个专门设计的投资者教育网站，我们开展了一项实地实验，通过社交媒体向中国及美国的投资者分享关于会计应计项目定价的见解。研究发现，相较于对照组股票，处理组股票的应计项目错误定价有所减少。当增强对应计项目概念理解的知识与辅助应计项目量化应用的知识相结合时，这一效应尤为显著。此外，在处理组中，那些更深入参与教育内容但金融素养较低的投资者所持有的股票，其处理效应更为增强。

title: Crowdsourcing from Hackers: Strategic Coopetition and Governance in Bug Bounty Programs
title_zh: 众包黑客：漏洞赏金计划中的战略竞合与治理
title_primary: 众包黑客：漏洞赏金计划中的战略竞合与治理
title_secondary: Crowdsourcing from Hackers: Strategic Coopetition and Governance in Bug Bounty Programs
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In a bug bounty program (BBP), organizations incentivize hackers—who could otherwise be “enemies”—to report security vulnerabilities by publicly offering monetary rewards. This paper develops an analytical framework to characterize BBPs and their strategic and economic impacts. Strategically, BBPs induce some hackers to self-select into cooperative vulnerability discovery and reporting, diverting them away from attacking (attack diversion) and delegating part of the protection effort to them (protection delegation). We show that (i) BBPs can be beneficial even when hackers are inefficient at vulnerability identification, yet more participants might make BBPs less attractive to firms. (ii) Although BBPs improve security, they might encourage competitive hackers (i.e., attackers) to exert more efforts. (iii) The coopetition dynamics can render a firm’s provision of rewards and in-house efforts socially inefficient. Common cybersecurity regulations, such as breach penalties and bounty reward subsidies, may exacerbate the inefficiency. We find complementarity between bounty subsidies and breach penalties, suggesting that combining and customizing them according to firm characteristics could enhance BBP efficiency. (iv) Contrary to the conventional wisdom that crowdsourcing rewards increase with participant size, we identify scenarios in which a firm should reduce or make nonmonotonic adjustments to a bounty reward as participant size increases. (v) Legal safe harbor for security testing or policies that reduce duplicate report submissions can lower firm payoffs under BBPs. We draw related implications for research and practice in information security and crowdsourcing. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682 .
abstract_zh: 在漏洞赏金计划（BBP）中，组织通过公开提供金钱奖励，激励那些原本可能成为“敌人”的黑客报告安全漏洞。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画BBP及其战略和经济影响。从战略角度看，BBP促使部分黑客自我选择参与合作性的漏洞发现与报告，从而将其从攻击行为中转移（攻击转移），并将部分防护工作委托给他们（防护委托）。我们表明：（i）即使黑客在漏洞识别方面效率不高，BBP也可能有益，但参与者增多可能使企业对BBP的兴趣降低。（ii）尽管BBP提升了安全性，但它们可能鼓励竞争性黑客（即攻击者）投入更多努力。（iii）这种合作竞争动态可能导致企业提供的奖励和内部努力在社会效率上不尽如人意。常见的网络安全法规，如违规处罚和赏金补贴，可能加剧这种低效率。我们发现赏金补贴与违规处罚之间存在互补性，表明根据企业特征进行组合和定制可以提升BBP效率。（iv）与传统观念认为众包奖励随参与者规模增加而增加相反，我们识别出一些情境，其中企业应随着参与者规模增加而减少或非单调调整赏金奖励。（v）为安全测试提供的法律安全港或减少重复报告提交的政策，可能降低企业在BBP下的收益。我们为信息安全与众包领域的研究和实践提出了相关启示。本文被信息系统方向编辑Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：本研究部分受香港特别行政区研究资助局优配研究金项目16503620支持。补充材料：在线附录见https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682。

authors: Bhagath Cheela, André DeHon, Jesús Fernández‐Villaverde, Alessandro Peri
official: 官方在线 2022-04-05 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show how to use field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and their associated high-level synthesis (HLS) compilers to solve heterogeneous agent models with incomplete markets and aggregate uncertainty (Krusell and Smith, 1998). We document that the acceleration delivered by one single FPGA is comparable to that provided by using 74 CPU cores in a conventional cluster. We describe how to achieve multiple acceleration opportunities—pipeline, data-level parallelism, and data precision—with minimal modification of the C code written for a traditional sequential processor, which we then deploy on FPGAs easily available at Amazon Web Services. We quantify the speedup and cost of these accelerations. Our paper is the first step toward a new field, electrical engineering economics, focused on designing computational accelerators for economics to tackle challenging quantitative models.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用现场可编程门阵列（FPGAs）及其相关的高级综合（HLS）编译器，来解决具有不完全市场和总体不确定性的异质主体模型（Krusell and Smith, 1998）。我们记录到，单个FPGA提供的加速效果可与传统集群中使用74个CPU核心相媲美。我们描述了如何以对传统顺序处理器编写的C代码进行最小修改的方式，实现多种加速机会——流水线、数据级并行和数据精度——随后将这些代码部署在亚马逊网络服务上易于获取的FPGAs上。我们量化了这些加速带来的速度提升和成本。我们的论文是向新领域——电气工程经济学——迈出的第一步，该领域专注于为经济学设计计算加速器，以应对具有挑战性的定量模型。

title: Sustainable urban growth scenario for climate-vulnerable coastal cities: An analysis based on ubiquitous big data and a hybrid fuzzy-cellular automata

authors: B. Skoczeń, Sina Sadeghfam, Seyed Mostafa Hedayatnezhad Kashi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Coastal cities face significant challenges in urban growth planning due to rapid urbanization, exposure to natural hazards, and heightened vulnerability to climate change. These challenges are particularly acute in developing countries, which host nearly 90% of at-risk coastal populations. However, effective planning in these contexts is often constrained by the scarcity of reliable spatial data. To address this issue, this study integrates ubiquitous big data sources and SDG-based parameters to develop a Sustainable Urban Growth Scenario (SUGS) and a Normal Urban Growth Scenario (NUGS). A hybrid cellular automata approach combining Fuzzy-CA and CA-Markov was applied to project land-use change in Chabahar and Konarak on Iran’s Makran coast. Results indicate that under NUGS, the cities may expand by over 1.9 million hectares by 2050, leading to extensive development within environmentally sensitive zones. In contrast, SUGS promotes a leapfrog development pattern. This study contributes an SDG-guided, ubiquitous big data-driven framework for guiding urban growth in coastal cities facing environmental challenges. The findings offer useful insights for policymakers and regional planners seeking to support resilient coastal urban management and disaster risk reduction, particularly in least developed countries.
abstract_zh: 沿海城市在快速城市化、自然灾害暴露以及气候变化脆弱性加剧的背景下，面临着城市增长规划的重大挑战。这些挑战在发展中国家尤为严峻，这些国家集中了全球近90%的沿海高风险人口。然而，在这些地区进行有效规划往往受限于可靠空间数据的稀缺。为解决这一问题，本研究整合了泛在性大数据源和基于可持续发展目标（SDG）的参数，开发了可持续城市增长情景（SUGS）和常态城市增长情景（NUGS）。采用结合模糊元胞自动机（Fuzzy-CA）和CA-Markov的混合元胞自动机方法，对伊朗马克兰海岸的恰巴哈尔和科纳拉克的土地利用变化进行了预测。结果表明，在NUGS情景下，到2050年这些城市可能扩张超过190万公顷，导致环境敏感区内的大规模开发。相比之下，SUGS情景则促进了跳跃式发展模式。本研究提供了一个以SDG为导向、泛在性大数据驱动的框架，用于指导面临环境挑战的沿海城市的城市增长。研究结果为政策制定者和区域规划者提供了有益见解，以支持韧性沿海城市管理和灾害风险降低，特别是在最不发达国家。

title: Application fees and the robustness of Nash equilibria in school choice
title_zh: 申请费与学校选择中纳什均衡的稳健性
title_primary: 申请费与学校选择中纳什均衡的稳健性
title_secondary: Application fees and the robustness of Nash equilibria in school choice
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the robustness of Nash equilibria in the preference revelation game induced by the student-optimal stable mechanism when small application fees are introduced. Assuming lexicographic preferences over outcomes, we show that introducing application fees reduces the set of Nash equilibria, to the detriment of student welfare. We provide a sufficient condition on the distribution of application fees that eliminates any Pareto improvement in which a student strictly benefits from being assigned to a given school. When all application fees are strictly positive for all applications, every Nash equilibrium induces a stable assignment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引入小额申请费的情况下，由学生最优稳定机制引发的偏好揭示博弈中纳什均衡的稳健性。假设对结果具有字典序偏好，我们表明引入申请费会减少纳什均衡的集合，从而损害学生福利。我们提供了申请费分布的一个充分条件，该条件消除了任何帕累托改进，其中学生因被分配到特定学校而严格受益。当所有申请费对所有申请均为严格正数时，每个纳什均衡都会产生一个稳定分配。

title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应
title_primary: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应
title_secondary: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。

title: Preferences for redistribution policies among politicians and citizens
title_zh: 政客与公民对再分配政策的偏好
title_primary: 政客与公民对再分配政策的偏好
title_secondary: Preferences for redistribution policies among politicians and citizens
authors: Javier Olivera, Christian Breunig, Troy S. Broderstad, Patrick Dumont, Maj-Britt Sterba
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper compares the “mental maps” of redistribution among politicians and citizens across seven parliaments, using original in-person surveys of sitting MPs and nationally representative citizen samples. Fairness beliefs and ideology are the strongest correlates of support for redistribution in both groups, while misperceptions of wealth concentration matter for citizens but much less for politicians. A central finding is that politicians hold markedly more polarized views on redistribution than citizens, including within the same party families. We also find systematic elite-voter gaps: left MPs are more supportive than their voters (notably on inheritance taxation), whereas right/liberal MPs are less supportive than theirs. These patterns point to a representation concern and to a narrower bargaining space among elites than in the electorate.
abstract_zh: 本文通过对比七个议会中政治人物与公民关于再分配的“心智地图”，采用了针对现任议员的原创面对面调查及具有全国代表性的公民样本。公平信念与意识形态是两组群体中支持再分配的最强相关因素，而对财富集中度的误解对公民影响显著，但对政治人物影响较小。一个核心发现是，政治人物在再分配问题上的观点比公民更为极化，即便在同一政党家族内部也是如此。我们还发现了系统性的精英-选民差距：左翼议员比其选民更支持再分配（尤其在遗产税方面），而右翼/自由派议员则比其选民更不支持。这些模式指向了一个代表性关切，以及精英阶层内部的谈判空间比选民群体更为狭窄。

title: How does the rural land management right mortgage loan programme affect rural household land renting-out? Evidence from China
title_zh: 农村土地经营权抵押贷款项目如何影响农户土地转出？——来自中国的证据
title_primary: 农村土地经营权抵押贷款项目如何影响农户土地转出？——来自中国的证据
title_secondary: How does the rural land management right mortgage loan programme affect rural household land renting-out? Evidence from China
authors: Fan Zhang, Xulin Wang, Xiaoting Yang, Zongzhi Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Credit constraints can limit land consolidation in developing economies, even when land rental markets are formally available. This paper studies China’s land management right mortgage lending pilot programme, which allows rural households to pledge land management rights—rather than land ownership—as collateral. Using household panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points from 2009 to 2019 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the programme increases land renting-out by rural households. The effect is larger after the 2019 revision of the Rural Land Contract Law, which codified the use of land management rights as collateral and reduced legal uncertainty. The programme also changes the allocation of rented-out land: land is increasingly transferred to larger and more capitalized agricultural operators rather than to ordinary smallholders. Evidence on formal bank credit and village-level land rents is consistent with a collateral-value mechanism. The reform improves access to credit for households with greater scale potential and raises rental returns, strengthening incentives to supply land to the rental market. These findings show that legally secured land collateralization can facilitate land reallocation, but may also shift market power towards better-capitalized operators.
abstract_zh: 信贷约束可能限制发展中国家的土地整合，即使土地租赁市场在形式上已存在。本文研究了中国土地经营权抵押贷款试点项目，该项目允许农村家庭以土地经营权（而非土地所有权）作为抵押品。利用2009年至2019年中国全国固定观察点的家庭面板数据，并结合双重差分设计，我们发现该项目增加了农村家庭的土地转出行为。在2019年《农村土地承包法》修订后，这一效应更为显著，该修订将土地经营权作为抵押品的使用纳入法律框架，并降低了法律不确定性。该项目还改变了转出土地的分配格局：土地越来越多地流向规模更大、资本化程度更高的农业经营者，而非普通小农户。关于正规银行贷款和村级土地租金的证据与抵押品价值机制相一致。该改革为具有更大规模潜力的家庭改善了信贷获取渠道，并提高了租金回报，从而增强了向租赁市场供应土地的激励。这些发现表明，法律保障的土地抵押化能够促进土地再配置，但也可能将市场力量向资本化程度更高的经营者转移。

title: Voter Information and Distributive Politics
title_zh: 选民信息与分配政治
title_primary: 选民信息与分配政治
title_secondary: Voter Information and Distributive Politics
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does more information benefit voters? I examine this question in a novel setting of distributive politics and electoral accountability. Homogeneously informed electorates can benefit from less information through improvements in the control or screening of politicians. For heterogeneously informed electorates, I show that the distribution of resources and voter welfare is affected by the nature of informational heterogeneity and by voters’ ability to communicate with each other, making less-informed voters better off than their more-informed counterparts in some cases. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H50)
abstract_zh: 更多信息是否有利于选民？我在分配政治与选举问责这一新颖情境中探讨了该问题。信息同质的选民群体可能因信息减少而受益，这源于对政治家控制或筛选机制的改善。对于信息异质的选民群体，研究表明资源分配与选民福利受信息异质性特征及选民间沟通能力的影响，在某些情况下信息较少的选民反而比信息更多的选民处境更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H50）

title: Population and Welfare: Measuring Growth when Life is Worth Living
title_zh: 人口与福利：当生命值得生活时如何衡量增长
title_primary: 人口与福利：当生命值得生活时如何衡量增长
title_secondary: Population and Welfare: Measuring Growth when Life is Worth Living
authors: Adhami, Mohamad, Bils, Mark, Jones, Charles I., Klenow, Peter J.
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Economic growth is typically measured in per capita terms. A long tradition in philosophy, however, suggests that social welfare may depend on the number of people as well. To illustrate how much this matters quantitatively, we decompose welfare growth — measured in consumption-equivalent (CE) units — into contributions from rising population and rising per capita consumption. Because of diminishing marginal utility from consumption, population growth is scaled up by a value-of-life factor that empirically averages nearly 3 across countries since 1960. Population increases are therefore a major contributor to growth if one takes a total utilitarian perspective.
abstract_zh: 经济增长通常以人均指标衡量。然而，哲学领域的悠久传统表明，社会福利可能同样取决于人口数量。为量化这一影响程度，我们将福利增长（以消费等价单位衡量）分解为人口增长与人均消费增长的贡献。由于消费边际效用递减，人口增长需乘以生命价值因子进行加权——该因子自1960年以来跨国实证均值接近3。因此，若采用总体功利主义视角，人口增长将成为经济增长的主要贡献因素。

title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
title_primary: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
title_secondary: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。

title: Agricultural commercialization and productivity: Evidence from land market participation in rural China
title_zh: 农业商业化与生产率：来自中国农村土地市场参与的实证证据
title_primary: 农业商业化与生产率：来自中国农村土地市场参与的实证证据
title_secondary: Agricultural commercialization and productivity: Evidence from land market participation in rural China
authors: Jian Zhang, Ashok K. Mishra, Maximilian Koppenberg, Linyi Zheng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。

title: Social Science Research 6.0: A Proof-of-Integrity Framework for Tamper-Evident Survey Instruments Using an Open-Source R Package
title_zh: 社会科学研究6.0：基于开源R包的可防篡改调查工具完整性证明框架
title_primary: 社会科学研究6.0：基于开源R包的可防篡改调查工具完整性证明框架
title_secondary: Social Science Research 6.0: A Proof-of-Integrity Framework for Tamper-Evident Survey Instruments Using an Open-Source R Package
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Survey-based social science research increasingly depends on digital questionnaires, browserbased data collection, automated statistical workflows, and reproducible reports. Yet the integrity of the research objects that connect these stages remains weak in many projects. Questionnaire files, response datasets, analysis scripts, and reports are often stored as separate artefacts, and when any one of them is changed after fieldwork or after submission, reviewers and institutions may lack a simple way to verify whether the file is identical to the version used earlier. This paper proposes Social Science Research 6.0 as a proof-of-integrity framework for tamper-evident survey workflows. The framework uses SHA-256 hashing to assign verifiable digests to survey instruments, response datasets, analysis plans, scripts, and report outputs, and records them in a structured manifest that can be verified at any later point. The approach is demonstrated using surveyframe, an open-source R package that represents a questionnaire as a typed survey object, saves it as a hashed .sframe file, validates item and scale structure, reads response data, checks quality, scores scales, prepares analysis plans, and generates reproducible reports. A synthetic proof-of-concept confirms that the framework detects instrument modification, response tampering, and analysis-plan drift in all tested scenarios. The contribution is a low-cost, software-only method for improving trust, transparency, and auditability in digital social science research without requiring blockchain infrastructure or proprietary survey platforms.
abstract_zh: 基于问卷调查的社会科学研究日益依赖于数字化问卷、基于浏览器的数据收集、自动化统计工作流程以及可复现报告。然而，连接这些环节的研究对象完整性在许多项目中仍然薄弱。问卷文件、响应数据集、分析脚本和报告往往作为独立工件存储，当其中任何一个在实地调查后或提交后被修改时，审稿人和机构可能缺乏简单的方法来验证该文件是否与先前使用的版本一致。本文提出社会科学研究6.0（Social Science Research 6.0）作为防篡改调查工作流的完整性证明框架。该框架使用SHA-256哈希为调查工具、响应数据集、分析计划、脚本和报告输出分配可验证的摘要，并将其记录在结构化清单中，可在后续任何时间点进行验证。该方法通过surveyframe这一开源R包进行演示，该包将问卷表示为类型化的调查对象，保存为哈希化的.sframe文件，验证条目和量表结构，读取响应数据，检查质量，对量表进行评分，准备分析计划，并生成可复现报告。一项合成概念验证确认，该框架在所有测试场景中均能检测到工具修改、响应篡改和分析计划漂移。其贡献在于提供一种低成本、纯软件的方法，在不依赖区块链基础设施或专有调查平台的情况下，提升数字社会科学研究的可信度、透明度和可审计性。

title: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
title_zh: 跨期限预测偏差：通胀预期与国债收益率
title_primary: 跨期限预测偏差：通胀预期与国债收益率
title_secondary: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I show that the overreaction of the long-term yield forecasts to yield news, evidenced in recent studies, results directly from the overreaction of long-horizon inflation forecasts to inflation news. Motivated by this finding, I study how agents form inflation expectations across forecast horizons. Short-horizon survey forecasts underreact, while long-horizon forecasts overreact to inflation news. To reconcile this behavior, I implement a long-run bias, building on the widely shared intuition that agents conflate transitory with permanent shocks, within a realistic trend-gap inflation model. I embed this bias within a yield curve model. The long-horizon inflation expectations overreaction translates into a long-term yields’ overreaction, generating excess yield sensitivity to news. The model implies a long-term bond risk premium substantially less volatile and cyclical than that implied by predictive regressions or estimates imposing full-information rational expectations.
abstract_zh: 我证明，近期研究中发现的长期收益率预测对收益率消息的过度反应，直接源于长期通胀预测对通胀消息的过度反应。基于这一发现，我研究了经济主体在不同预测期限上如何形成通胀预期。短期调查预测对通胀消息反应不足，而长期预测则反应过度。为调和这一行为，我在一个现实的趋势-缺口通胀模型中引入长期偏差，基于广泛认同的直觉，即经济主体将暂时性冲击与永久性冲击混淆。我将这一偏差嵌入收益率曲线模型。长期通胀预期的过度反应转化为长期收益率的过度反应，产生收益率对消息的过度敏感性。该模型意味着长期债券风险溢价的波动性和周期性显著低于预测回归或强加完全信息理性预期估计所隐含的水平。

title: Simulating Heavy-Tailed Economic Data with Quantum Boltzmann Machines: Applications to Downside Risk in Firms with Limited Histories
title_zh: 使用量子玻尔兹曼机模拟重尾经济数据：在有限历史企业下行风险中的应用
title_primary: 使用量子玻尔兹曼机模拟重尾经济数据：在有限历史企业下行风险中的应用
title_secondary: Simulating Heavy-Tailed Economic Data with Quantum Boltzmann Machines: Applications to Downside Risk in Firms with Limited Histories
authors: Noorain Noorani, Valerio Astuti, Giuseppe Bruno, Lerby M. Ergun, Vladimir Skavysh
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accurately estimating tail risk in financial markets is crucial yet difficult, especially when data are scarce. This paper investigates the use of Quantum Boltzmann Machines (QBMs), a class of quantum generative models capable of capturing complex, high-dimensional, and heavy-tailed distributions through quantum superposition and entanglement. Compared to classical Restricted Boltzmann Machines, QBMs offer greater expressive power and sampling efficiency. We apply this framework to assess risk for newly listed firms with limited historical data and find that QBM-augmented estimates significantly improve the prediction of long-term risk measures, including Value-at-Risk and expected shortfall, making QBMs a promising tool for financial modeling.
abstract_zh: 准确评估金融市场的尾部风险至关重要，但尤其在数据稀缺时颇具挑战。本文探讨了量子玻尔兹曼机（QBMs）的应用，这是一类能够通过量子叠加和纠缠捕捉复杂、高维及重尾分布的量子生成模型。与经典受限玻尔兹曼机相比，QBMs展现出更强的表达能力和采样效率。我们将此框架应用于评估历史数据有限的新上市公司的风险，并发现QBM增强的估计显著提升了对长期风险度量（包括风险价值与预期短缺）的预测能力，使QBMs成为金融建模中颇具前景的工具。

title_primary: 买方垄断不仅使企业规模变小，还导致其低效率：东德为何未能实现经济趋同
title_secondary: Monopsony Makes Firms Not Only Small but Also Unproductive: Why East Germany has Not Converged
authors: Rüdiger Bachmann, Christian Bayer, Heiko Stüber, Felix Wellschmied
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.
abstract_zh: 当雇主面临规模扩张与低工资之间的权衡——即在此意义上拥有买方垄断势力时，部分高生产率雇主会选择放弃构建庞大的商业网络、牺牲销售额并维持小规模经营。这些决策对总体劳动生产率产生不利影响。基于德国高质量行政数据，我们证实东德工厂（相较于西德工厂）面临更陡峭的规模-工资曲线，商业网络投资更少，企业规模更小，且生产率更低。一个包含劳动力市场买方垄断、产品市场势力及商业网络投资特征（与数据特征相匹配）的模型预测，东德总体劳动生产率将因此降低10%。

title: Dynamic Mode Decompositions and Vector Autoregressions
title_zh: 动态模态分解与向量自回归
title_primary: 动态模态分解与向量自回归
title_secondary: Dynamic Mode Decompositions and Vector Autoregressions
authors: Thomas J. Sargent, Yatheesan J. Selvakumar, Ziyue Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We establish connections between dynamic mode decompositions (DMDs), vector autoregressions, and linear state-space models, showing that DMD provides a computationally efficient, SVD-based estimator of low-rank first-order VAR projection coefficients in high-dimensional settings. When the measurement matrix has full column rank, the recovered nonzero eigenvalues coincide with those of the underlying state transition matrix. We apply DMD to a 100-household heterogeneous-agent economy with complete markets and Gorman aggregation. From high-dimensional household income and consumption panels, DMD recovers latent aggregate dynamics, and cross-sectional loadings reveal the sharing rule governing redistribution, demonstrating DMD's capacity to extract economically meaningful structure from microeconomic panels.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了动态模式分解（DMDs）、向量自回归与线性状态空间模型之间的联系，表明在高维设定下，DMD提供了一种基于SVD的计算高效的低秩一阶VAR投影系数估计器。当测量矩阵具有满列秩时，恢复的非零特征值与底层状态转移矩阵的特征值一致。我们将DMD应用于一个包含100个家庭、具有完全市场和高尔曼聚合的异质性主体经济模型。从高维家庭收入与消费面板数据中，DMD恢复了潜在的总体动态，而横截面载荷揭示了支配再分配的共享规则，展示了DMD从微观经济面板中提取经济上有意义结构的能力。

title: FX Interventions and Capital‐Constrained Banks: Evidence from USD/ILS Spot, Forward, and Option Markets
title_zh: 外汇干预与资本约束银行：来自美元/以色列谢克尔即期、远期和期权市场的证据
title_primary: 外汇干预与资本约束银行：来自美元/以色列谢克尔即期、远期和期权市场的证据
title_secondary: FX Interventions and Capital‐Constrained Banks: Evidence from USD/ILS Spot, Forward, and Option Markets
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-02-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using confidential daily data, we examine the Bank of Israel's foreign exchange interventions from 2013 to 2019. We find that a 1 billion U.S. dollars (USD) purchase leads to a 0.82% depreciation of the Israeli Shekel (ILS)–a strong effect compared to other studies. We show that this effectiveness can partially be attributed to the limited risk‐taking capacity of global banks. The interventions also widen the negative deviation from covered interest parity and influence the higher‐order moments of risk‐neutral expectations derived from options prices. We find that USD purchases shift the USD/ILS distribution upward and reduce crash risk. Moreover, the options market anticipates and prices in upcoming interventions.
abstract_zh: 利用机密日度数据，我们考察了2013年至2019年间以色列银行的外汇干预行为。研究发现，10亿美元（USD）的购买导致以色列谢克尔（ILS）贬值0.82%——这一效果相较于其他研究更为显著。我们表明，这种有效性部分可归因于全球银行有限的风险承担能力。干预措施还扩大了与抛补利率平价的负偏离，并影响了从期权价格推导出的风险中性预期的高阶矩。我们发现，美元购买使USD/ILS汇率分布上移，并降低了崩盘风险。此外，期权市场能够预期并提前定价即将到来的干预措施。

title: The Health Effects of In Utero Exposure To Cash Transfers
title_zh: 产前现金转移暴露的健康效应
title_primary: 产前现金转移暴露的健康效应
title_secondary: The Health Effects of In Utero Exposure To Cash Transfers
official: 官方在线 2025-10-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects of in utero exposure to a large cash transfer program on the health of children. Using data from South Africa, we use the age-eligibility threshold of the Older Person’s Grant and the variation in age differences between children and a coresident elderly to show that in utero exposure to the cash transfer led to a 0.26 SD increase in height-for-age of children. Among older children, we leverage the variation in the timing of the start of benefits to show important out-sized benefits of in utero exposure compared to starting later in early life. These results are robust to a variety of different checks including controlling for endogenous household formation. Given the importance of early child health in determining long-term outcomes, our results suggest that extending child-specific cash transfer programs to pregnant mothers can have long-term positive impacts.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了子宫内暴露于大规模现金转移项目对儿童健康的影响。利用南非的数据，我们依据老年人补助金的年龄资格门槛及儿童与同住老年人年龄差异的变化，证明子宫内暴露于现金转移使儿童身高别年龄指数提高了0.26个标准差。在年龄较大的儿童中，我们利用福利开始时间的差异，展示了与生命早期较晚阶段开始相比，子宫内暴露带来的显著超额益处。这些结果在多种检验下依然稳健，包括控制内生性家庭构成。鉴于早期儿童健康对长期结果的决定性作用，我们的研究结果表明，将针对儿童的现金转移项目扩展至孕妇，可产生长期的积极影响。

title: Discrete and Continuous Preference Heterogeneity in a Kuhn-Tucker Model: Beach Recreational Demand
title_zh: 库恩-塔克模型中的离散与连续偏好异质性：海滩休闲需求
title_primary: 库恩-塔克模型中的离散与连续偏好异质性：海滩休闲需求
title_secondary: Discrete and Continuous Preference Heterogeneity in a Kuhn-Tucker Model: Beach Recreational Demand
official: 官方在线 2021-09-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study extended an existing Kuhn-Tucker (KT) model to integrate a mixture of discrete and continuous preference heterogeneity to address taste variations at individual and group levels. Specifically, we introduced random parameters into site quality attributes in a latent segmentation KT framework. In an empirical application to beach recreational demand, our proposed model statistically dominated other conventional specifications and revealed heterogeneous preferences for beach quality across and within groups. Our welfare analysis further showed that ignoring either the continuous or discrete component of the mixing distributions might lead to biased welfare estimates as well as opposite policy implications. JEL Q51C51
abstract_zh: 本研究在现有Kuhn-Tucker（KT）模型基础上进行了扩展，融合了离散与连续偏好异质性，以应对个体及群体层面的品味差异。具体而言，我们在潜在分段KT框架中，将随机参数引入场地质量属性。在针对海滩休闲需求的实证应用中，我们提出的模型在统计上优于其他传统设定，并揭示了海滩质量偏好在群体间及群体内的异质性。福利分析进一步表明，忽略混合分布中的连续或离散成分可能导致福利估计偏差及相反的政策含义。JEL分类号：Q51，C51
